Board of Directors: • Sets the tone and influences the risk management culture within the Company
• Approves major decisions affecting the company’s investment portfolio and its risk profile

The Audit and Risk • Reviews the Company’s approach to risk management
Committee • Advises the Board on the effectiveness of policies and procedures for risk assessment and risk
management

Internal Audit • Assists the audit and risk committee in ensuring that internal processes and procedures are
(Out sourced): adequate and complied with
Management: • Implements the Board’s risk management policy
